Deepest condolences to President Yang Fujia, the "spark-planter" who promoted the development of higher education in China
19 July 2022
Yang Fujia, a renowned nuclear physicist, educator, member of the China Central Institute for Culture and History, academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, former president of Fudan University, former Chancellor of the University of Nottingham in the UK and the president of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China, passed away in Shanghai on 17 July 2022 due to illness at the age of 86.
As a world-renowned nuclear physicist, academician Yang Fujia established a first-class laboratory in China – the "Accelerator-based Atomic and Nuclear Physics Laboratory", which pioneered the research field of ion beam analysis in China and made outstanding contributions to applied physics research.
As an educator who had a rich knowledge of both Western and Chinese higher education, President Yang Fujia worked tirelessly to promote the development of China’s higher education throughout his life. He spoke and wrote actively on various occasions to promote the establishment of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China, which opened a new model of sino-foreign cooperative education.
President Yang Fujia once said that the difference between people lies in the “flame” in their hearts. He advocated the idea of liberal arts education and constantly encouraged students to explore and ignite the “flame” that seeks true knowledge. As a "spark-planter" of advanced educational concepts, President Yang Fujia had an extensive and far-reaching impact on the development of higher education in China.
Promoting the establishment of the first sino-foreign university in China
Academician Yang Fujia was the first Chinese national to serve as the Chancellor of the University of Nottingham in the UK. It was also the first time in history that a Chinese national was honored to serve as the Chancellor of a famous British university.
Serving at the helm of well-known universities at home and abroad for many years, Yang Fujia had profound insights into the development of higher education and talent cultivation. He advocated the idea of liberal arts education, speaking and writing actively on various occasions to promote the reform of higher education in China. He once said: “I was fortunate enough to be the Chancellor of the University of Nottingham in the UK for 12 years. I visited countless universities around the world and gradually understood what liberal arts education is. Naturally, I am also thinking about whether this excellent teaching system can be migrated to China.”
In 2003, the promulgation of the “Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Chinese-Foreign Cooperation in Running Schools” created a positive environment and legal ground for the establishment of sino-foreign universities. At the same time, Xu Yafen, the co-founder of Wanli Education Group, also expressed her wish of cooperation with the University of Nottingham to President Yang Fujia to establish the first sino-foreign university in Ningbo, hoping that Chinese students would be able to study in a world-famous university at home rather than abroad, which coincided with President Yang Fujia's idea seamlessly. Two months later, accompanied by Chancellor Yang, Sir Colin Campbell, the Vice-Chancellor of the University of Nottingham at that time, visited Ningbo. In the presence of Chancellor Yang, the University of Nottingham signed a letter of intent with Wanli Education Group.
In 2004, the first sino-foreign university in China, the University of Nottingham Ningbo China was established. This remarkable event was included in the "60 major events in the 60 years of education in new China" by the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China.
Adhering to the "Three Principles" and always seek excellence
During his tenure as president of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China, President Yang Fujia advocated liberal art education, emphasising "human beings first, professionals second".
His "Three Principles" on education were widely spread. Firstly, "The key to running a good university is quality, quality and quality."
When being awarded the title of Honorary Chancellor of the University of Nottingham in the UK, President Yang Fujia said, "The courage to face new challenges and continuously improve the quality of education will make the University of Nottingham Ningbo China not only the first sino-foreign university in China, but also the best university in China."
As President Yang Fujia had said, having the highest standard of quality of education guaranteed the success of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China today. In 2013, the British Higher Education Quality Assurance Agency (QAA) issued an evaluation report after an on-site teaching quality evaluation stating: the University of Nottingham Ningbo China adopts the education model and standards of the University of Nottingham, and its level of academic teaching and the quality of learning for students are completely consistent with the University of Nottingham in the UK.
Secondly, according to President Yang Fujia, "a student's mind is not just a vessel to be filled with knowledge, but a spark to be ignited. Keep discovering your flame and let it burn!" In his view, education was not simply about feeding knowledge, but igniting the flame inside one’s mind, developing and enlightening the inner potential of the person being educated, so that they will actively pursue new knowledge.
Under his vigorous advocacy, in addition to classroom teaching, the University of Nottingham Ningbo China has also made efforts in extracurricular activities to carry out diversified education models such as community practice, public welfare activities, employment guidance, and liberal arts classes to help students ignite the spark.
To encourage outstanding students who performed well in extracurricular activities and worked hard for their dreams, in 2013, President Yang Fujia generously donated a significant sum of money to the University of Nottingham Ningbo China Education Foundation to establish the Dream Scholarship.
Thirdly, President Yang Fujia attached great importance to undergraduate teaching and advocated that professors should teach undergraduate students, especially first-year students, which would help to improve the students' vision and broaden their horizons. "We should adopt a 'student-centred approach' to education", said President Yang Fujia. Educating students is always the top priority of the University. With small-sized classes, interactive seminars, and a diversified assessment system, in the University of Nottingham Ningbo China, the quality of learning and personal development of every student is given the highest attention.
Every year at orientation and graduation ceremonies, President Yang Fujia always came to the University to interact with the students cordially, with this tradition going on for many years. In July 2021, the 85- year-old President Yang still insisted on being present to send his blessings to the graduates. At this year's graduation ceremony, he encouraged the graduates through a letter: "I hope that wherever you go from here or whatever you do in the future, you will light up the world with your spark of fire."
The spark of liberal arts education has become a fire across the prairie
President Yang Fujia's educational philosophy deeply influenced many of our students, with him receiving many letters from students stating "the University has changed our lives". The students also lived up to President Yang's expectations, exploring their inner flame, pursuing their dreams, and shining across the globe. Some examples of this include:
Yu Yejiong, a graduate of Environmental Engineering in 2016, and a core member of a research team, developed a COVID-19 test kit, which has been widely used in developing countries.
Qiu Jiayi, a graduate of Architectural Environment Engineering in 2015, won the "You Bring Charm to the World Award" together with Yu Min, the father of the hydrogen bomb.
"YiKun Sports", a student entrepreneurship project, stepped out of the campus and became the first and only company in China that has the entire frisbee sport industry chain of supply and distribution under its grasp, shipping frisbees to more than 50 countries and regions in the world.
In just 18 years since the establishment of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China, seven of our alumni have been listed on Forbes' Under 30 list.
From 2004 to 2022, more than 20,000 of our students have traveled to different parts of the world. Global vision, critical thinking, teamwork and the ability to solve complex problems are often mentioned by famous universities and enterprises in the world when they talk about students who studied at the University of Nottingham Ningbo China. President Yang Fujia once said at a graduation ceremony, "Believe in yourselves, this University has given you enough knowledge to excel at all kinds of professions. Secondly, no matter how you will go about your life, work in a company or study further, you will succeed as long as you work hard."
In view of the development of China's higher education system, President Yang Fujia also pointed out that different types of universities (research universities, general universities, or vocational colleges) need to have different evaluation systems. The development of different kinds of higher education systems should also be encouraged. Since the establishment of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China, a number of other sino-foreign universities have emerged in China.
On this experimental field of higher education at the University of Nottingham Ningbo China, the torch lit by President Yang Fujia not only brightened the flames in the hearts of our students, but also opened up a new path for China’s education to enter the world and promoted the internationalization and diversification of higher education.
President Yang Fujia passed away, but his spirit will be with us forever. Staff and students send in their love and tribute
Immediately after his death, flowers were placed at President Yang Fujia’s office door. Bright yellow chrysanthemum, pure white lily and cards filled with words of tribute are all showing people’s grief.
Since the news of President Yang's passing was released, the University of Nottingham Ningbo China has received many condolences and messages from staff, students and parents.
In President Yang's office, the lights are still on, the furniture and his personal belongings are in good order, and the calligraphy "Great virtues and blessings" still hangs on the wall. It seems he had never left us. His spirit will be with us forever and the flame he ignited will never die.

title: Condolences from Xu Yafen
content:
深切缅怀杨福家院士
全校师生、广大校友、朋友们:
今天,我们怀着极其沉痛的心情,在这里缅怀德高望重、深受师生爱戴的校长——杨福家院士。
杨福家院士因病于2022年7月17日在上海逝世,享年86岁。杨福家院士是宁波诺丁汉大学校长,也是我国著名核物理学家、教育家、中央文史研究馆馆员、中国科学院院士、复旦大学原校长。
2004年,杨福家院士为推动中国第一所中外合作大学——宁波诺丁汉大学的创建和发展、为中国教育的国际化做出了卓越贡献。作为首任校长,杨福家院士倡导博雅教育,以质量标准融通中外,强调“做人第一,修业第二”,点燃了学生心中探求真知的“火种”。杨福家校长毕生都在用实际行动践行自己的教育理念,产生了广泛而深远的影响。
高山仰止,景行行止。在惊悉杨福家校长辞世后,宁波市委市政府、社会各界均以各种方式表达深切哀悼之意,对此,宁波诺丁汉大学理事会和我个人深致谢意,共寄哀思!
斯人已逝,风范永存。让我们深切缅怀杨福家院士,牢记并传承其办学理念,全心全力办好宁波诺丁汉大学,不辜负杨校长的初心、夙愿。
徐亚芬宁波诺丁汉大学理事长

title: Condolences from Vice-Chancellor Shearer West
content:
I am writing on behalf of all of us at the University of Nottingham, and our extended family of alumni, to express our deepest sympathies.
President Professor Yang Fujia will remain fondly and proudly in our memories as a leader of immense vision and drive. So much of the University we know today would not be here without his influence as our sixth Chancellor.
As the news has filtered through our campuses many of his former colleagues around the world have expressed their sadness and shared memories of the many firsts he achieved, from his pioneering academic work to his vision for an education system that crossed global boundaries.
He was a true champion of educational reform in China but in pursuing this vision he helped to lay the foundations for change in the UK, starting with the University of Nottingham and leaving a legacy of opportunity for so many students around the world. His achievements and his name will resonate long into our futures both here and in Ningbo.
Professor Shearer West CBE
Executive Chair of UNNC Board
President and Vice-Chancellor

title: Condolences from Provost Nick Miles
content:
President Yang Fujia will be lovingly remembered by all of us, his friends and family, near and distant, and all those upon whom he made an everlasting impression of kindness, wisdom and generosity.
President Yang Fujia had achieved so much in his life. He was a renowned nuclear physicist, an educator, member of the China Central Institute for Culture and History, academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, but most of you will have known him as the former president of Fudan University, former Chancellor of the University of Nottingham in the UK and the president of University of Nottingham Ningbo China, which he was instrumental in establishing in 2004 as China's first sino-foreign university.
As the founding president of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China, he fulfilled his vision of ensuring high-quality teaching and cultivating outstanding student talent over the years. President Yang Fujia said a number of times that many graduate students mentioned in their letters to him that “the university has changed our lives”. We are all very grateful for President Yang Fujia’s profound insights and unprecedented contribution to the development of higher education and talent cultivation in China.
Professor Nick Miles OBE
Provost and Pro-Vice-Chancellor

title: Condolences from British Consul-General in Shanghai Chris Wood
content:
We were deeply saddened to learn of the untimely passing of President Yang Fujia.
Prof. Yang had deep connections with the UK, having served as Chancellor of the University of Nottingham from 2001 to 2013, the first Chinese academic to hold such a position at a British university. But we particularly remember him for his vision of setting up the University of Nottingham at Ningbo, which came to fruition in 2004, and which has been a model for subsequent UK-China transnational education collaboration.  In this and other ways, he made a major contribution to UK-China education partnerships, fostering mutual understanding of the education and culture of both countries.
The lives of countless British, Chinese and other students - including some of my team at the British Consulate-General in Shanghai - have been shaped by Prof. Yang's vision. We particularly remember his support for academic exchanges in emerging sectors such as sustainable energy, for the strength of UNNC's Faculty of Science and Engineering, and for UNNC's work on international studies and international communications.
The British Government has much valued its connections with Prof. Yang, for example during the Prime Minister's visit to China in 2013, where he shared some of the concrete results from UK-China education collaboration; and in marking the 10th anniversary of UNNC at the British Ambassador's Residence in Beijing in 2014.
Prof. Yang will be much missed by everyone connected with Nottingham Ningbo, but with gratitude for all that he achieved.  At this sad time, we send our deep condolences and heartfelt sympathy to Prof. Yang's family, to the faculty and current students at UNNC, and to all of the broader Nottingham and Nottingham Ningbo family.
Chris Wood
Her Majesty's Consul-General in ShanghaiBritish Consulate-General

title: Condolences from British Council
content:
It is with great sorrow that we have heard of the passing of President Yang Fujia.
At the British Council we remember him for his roles as Chancellor of the University of Nottingham UK, and his influence in establishing the University of Nottingham Ningbo. His support for the first sino-foreign university, the first of its kind, nearly 20 years ago demonstrated his vision and foresight. As President of Nottingham Ningbo he will always be remembered for his focus on academic quality and his interest in supporting young talent. He was an exemplar of values we hold dear, building bridges between the UK and China, upholding excellence in education, providing opportunities for young people. His contribution over the years has led to the outstanding reputation and success of Nottingham Ningbo today.
Please extend our sympathies to his family and friends, and to your faculty and students at this difficult time. He will be well remembered by us all.
With our very best wishes

Director China | British CouncilMinister (Culture and Education) | British Embassy Beijing
Gill Caldicott 季佳
Area Director, East China | British CouncilConsul (Culture and Education) | British Consulate-General

title: Condolences from Guangdong Hybribio Biotech
content:
惊悉我国著名核物理学家、教育家杨福家院士遽归道山,殊感震悼,万分悲恸。谨代表凯普集团全体员工表示沉痛哀悼,并向杨福家先生家属致以最深切的慰问。
杨福家院士是举世闻名的核物理学家、教育家,硕果累累, 桃李芬芳,为中国科学技术的发展和中华民族的复兴做出了巨大贡献。他的仙逝,是我国学术界、教育界的巨大损失。
我和杨福家院士是莫逆之交,相交相识 20 余年,多次聆听他的教诲,每次都是如饮甘醇,如沐春风。在杨福家先生“知识经济”与“科技创新”理念影响下与引领下,我和夫人王建瑜从教育报国的理想,转变为科技报国的抱负,创立香港凯普科创公司。创立之初,杨福家先生就为凯普的企业发展指出明路—— “凯普产业发展必须紧贴 21 世纪科技前沿”。因为有杨福家先生的指引,凯普迈进了知识经济领域,走上了科技创新、报效国家之路。因此,所有凯普人对杨福家先生非常崇敬和爱戴。
尤其令人没齿难忘的是,杨福家先生对我的知遇之恩。在担任宁波诺丁汉大学校长期间,他特聘我为宁波诺丁汉大学顾问委员会委员、宁波诺丁汉大学客座教授。并于 2015 年 5 月、2016 年 9 月和 2019 年 11 月,杨福家先生先后三次邀请我赴宁波诺丁汉大学,分别作《鲁迅与胡适》、《人与五个世界》以及《凯普回顾与展望》三次学术演讲,而且三次都是杨福家院士亲自主持,对我的学术报告给予了充满人文关怀与科学理性的高度评价。所以,杨福家先生不仅是凯普的引路人,也是我学术研究的知心人。滴水之恩,当涌泉相报。今年 6 月,在杨福家院士华诞来临之际, 我还代表凯普集团专门致信祝寿,诚挚地祝福杨先生在米寿之后,再成百岁人瑞,好让我们和凯普集团好好尽报恩之心。然而,天地失色,山河呜咽,杨福家院士病逝的消息突然传来,令我夫妇俩人,也令凯普集团全体员工沉浸在无限的悲痛之中。在此,唯有将一瓣心香,寄予杨福家先生的灵前,祈祝先生一路走好,在天堂好好安息! 同时,也恳切希望杨福家先生的家属节哀顺变,善自珍重!
泰山其颓,哲人其萎,然而其言谆谆,其容宛在,范典永垂! 杨福家院士的爱国情怀、高洁品格、治学态度和突出贡献如日月经天,江河行地,将永远令人铭记和怀念!
杨福家院士千古!
广东凯普生物科技股份有限公司 管乔中 王建瑜 衔悲泣写

title: Student Activity
content: Noticing the trend of incorporating innovation and entrepreneurship courses and training into the University curriculum, required by the Chinese Ministry of Education, UNNC has the opportunity to build up a supporting mechanism to unlock the potential of students to engage in a multiple level of competitions. The purpose of facilitating this project is mainly to rearrange and reallocate the existing resources and to create and develop a positive and supportive institutional environment for student competition development. The project is led by the Department of Campus Life NUBS Students Affairs Team, collaborated with all Faculty teams and the rest Student Affairs Teams. The project aims at initiating an efficient management system in supporting student competition development, from policymaking to award setting, and from administrative support to academic resources providing.

title: Scholarships and Grants
content: Golden Interns Award is an impactful internship experience award launched by Career Development Office and funded by the Foundation.  Since its inception in 2017, this project has received greater attention from the society, and had an educational and positive impact on our students, which further enhances the relationship between the internship companies, the University and the students. The purpose of this project is to encourage students who are brave in exploring and innovating, down-to-earth, and collaborative to share their internship results and experience, and to inspire more students to enhance their employability and career planning capability through the internship.

title: Teaching and Research
content: Yi Zhong He Healthcare Education Promotion Fund was donated by Madam Fangzhou, the founder of Yi Zhong He Herbal Plant and Ningbo’s outstanding female entrepreneur. It aims to promote the healthcare education, award the talent and group with excellent contribution in healthcare, drive the research and international collaboration of the Traditional Chinese Medicine, enhance the public health awareness and improve the health condition of the society. The fund will rely on the research excellence and broad network of Nottingham China Health Institute, to deliver a wide range of activities in research, education and exchange. In 2018-2019, the fund has already financially support the breast cancer programme by the GRADE (Ningbo China) Centre, the annual forum of Nottingham China Health Institute, a forum on healthy food and nutrition for the community. The total beneficiary is more than 300, with a sound social feedback and benefit.

title: Public Welfare
content: Passing Hope Project is a philanthropic project led by students, which works with local governments of rural areas of China. The project is a youth leadership project with students at the heart of the project, supported by adults. Passing Hope aims to install football pitches into communities across China that fall into the low socio-economic categorization - providing facilities to increase the opportunity for participation in sport. The project also provides a student delivered education programme alongside the provision of facilities. Subjects such as English, Math, Science, Art, PE and Music are taught and promoted, giving children of the local schools a unique experience.

title: Tax Exemption
content:
Tax Exemption Policies
According to article 9 of Enterprise Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China, in relation to the expenses from charitable donations incurred by enterprises, the portion within 12% of the total annual profit may be deducted from the taxable income; the portion exceeding 12% of the annual profit can be deducted from the taxable income over the following three years.
According to article 6 of Individual Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China, for charitable donations toward public interest, the portion within 30% of the taxable income can be deducted before tax when computing individual income tax.
According to article 80 of the Charity Law of the People's Republic of China, natural persons, legal persons and other organizations that donate property for charity activities are eligible for tax benefits. Charitable donations by corporations exceeding the amount deductible from income tax for the same year can be deducted from taxable income over the following three years.
According to the "Supplementary Notice of the Ministry of Finance, the State Administration of Taxation and the Ministry of Civil Affair of PRC on Issues Concerning the Pre-tax Deduction of Public Welfare Donations " (No. 160 [2008] of The Ministry of Finance and Taxation), the Education Foundation of the University of Nottingham Ningbo is a public welfare social organization that enjoys the pre-tax deduction qualification of public welfare donations.
According to "Announcement of Zhejiang Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation, Zhejiang Taxation Bureau, Zhejiang Civil Affairs Bureau on social organizations with public welfare donation pre-tax deduction qualification in 2018" (No. 3 [2018]), the Education Foundation of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China was listed, serial number 175.
According to "Announcement of Zhejiang Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation, Zhejiang Taxation Bureau, Zhejiang Civil Affairs Bureau on social organizations with public welfare donation pre-tax deduction qualification in 2019" (No. 11 [2019]), the Education Foundation of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China was listed, serial number 218.
According to "Announcement of Zhejiang Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation, Zhejiang Taxation Bureau, Zhejiang Civil Affairs Bureau on social organizations with public welfare donation pre-tax deduction qualification in 2020" (No. 8 [2020]), the Education Foundation of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China was listed, serial number 262.
According to "
Announcement of Zhejiang Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation, Zhejiang Taxation Bureau, Zhejiang Civil Affairs Bureau on social organizations with public welfare donation pre-tax deduction qualification in 2021-2023
" (No. 13 [2021]), the Education Foundation of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China was listed, serial number 100.

UNNC student wins international research prize
07 August 2020
Tianning Shao, a graduate of Architectural Environment Engineering, received first prize with a paper that he selected and co-wrote in the just-concluded global authoritative academic conference of SDEWES (Sustainable Development of Energy, Water and Environment Systems). His excellent research collaboration has won him offers to study at Cambridge, Imperial College and University College London.
The most unforgettable and significant experience during Tianning’s undergraduate study was his summer school programme at University of California, Berkeley during year one. Exciting to know the numerous exchange and study abroad at UNNC, Tianning found a course about fluid mechanics and building energy analysis. “But I didn’t know that its difficulty was far beyond the knowledge of a year one undergraduate before I went there – it was actually for year four students,” he said.
The professor noticed this extraordinarily young student in the class and took him to answer questions after each session. Intensive lectures, experiments, exams and group work – within two months his English language and academic ability improved drastically.
During the four years, Tianning stayed among the top 1-2% of his class and won various scholarships. He was soon clear that his interest lay in scientific research and actively sought research opportunities on and off-campus. In his third year, he participated in a summer research project at the University of Nottingham, where he used CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) to research the impact of vegetation barriers on indoor air quality and ventilation.
Tianning and his fellow students wrote the research results into a paper “Impacts of Urban Vegetation Barriers on Outdoor-Indoor Traffic Pollution Dispersion in Naturally Ventilated Spaces Along Street Canyons”, which won the prize at SDEWES.
“The project was closely related to what I have learned, and it also required a combination of knowledge from multiple disciplines," said Tianning. “The research on architecture is focused more on the relationships between the building and the surrounding environment. An excellent building should not only consider the basic principles of architecture and aesthetics, but also its environmental performance and economic value.”
The sensitivity and insight that Tianning has made him stand out and finally enabled him to continue his research and academic pursuit at Cambridge University.

title: Zhu Yue, passionate research masters student studying water and environmental science
content: In June 2020, Yue graduated from Hohai University majoring in environmental science. She received offers from several universities and institutions in the Netherlands with world-leading environmental science programmes. However, she chose a different path and embarked on a stimulating gap year. Yue travelled to the Ministry of Ecology and Environment of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region as an intern, where she assisted in reviewing the environmental assessment reports of the applied projects, organising project review meetings, and participating in field trips to river and lake projects. She took the initiative to communicate with UNNC's related research supervisors, explained her research direction, and finally received the admission offer for the MRes programme at UNNC. During her undergraduate studies, she participated in the university innovation training program and began to join the NSFC Project on the research of the movement characteristics of the confluence of river currents and the law of pollutant transport from her second year. As well as learning theoretical knowledge, she also carried out further scientific research practice. She said, "The scientific research experience also allowed me to clarify my future research fields and directions. During my postgraduate study, I focused on the study of single river courses hydrodynamic and water quality characteristics of estuaries.”

Dr Chung Hon Dak visited the University of Nottingham Ningbo China
19 May 2023
Dr Chung Hon Dak, a kind donor and supporter of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China, recently paid a visit to our Ningbo campus at the beginning of the month.
Dr Chung is the Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Hong Kong Wan Du Group Limited, the Chairman of the Chung Hon Dak Foundation, and the Chairman of the Zhou Guang Zhao Foundation. As well as this, Dr Chung is also a Committee of the 10th CPPCC of Hunan Province, the President of the Hong Kong Hunan Chamber of Commerce, and a well-known philanthropist. He is the recipient of many awards, including: Honorary University Fellows of the University of Hong Kong, Honorary Doctor of Laws of the University of Nottingham, and Honorary Doctor of Beijing Normal University.
Since the establishment of UNNC, Dr Chung Hon Dak and his wife, Lee Ko, have generously supported the mission, construction and development of the university. Providing funding for the establishment of the Kin-Kwok Chung Institute for Global Finance, Lee Ko Institute for Sustainable Development, and the Lesotho Scholarship and Chung Hon Dak Scholarship, their donations have exceeded RMB 20 million, benefitting several generations of UNNC teachers and students.
During the meeting, UNNC leaders warmly welcomed Dr Chung and expressed their gratitude for his support. UNNC leaders in attendance included Professor Wu Tao, Vice President of UNNC and Dean of the UNNC Faculty of Science and Engineering, Chief Financial and Planning Officer Mr Thomas Murphy, Professor Alain Chong, Dean of the UNNC Graduate School and Global Engagement, Professor Kok Wei Khong, Dean of the Nottingham University Business School (China) as well as Professor Guoping Cao and Ms Lily Ma of the University of Nottingham Shanghai Office, and Dr Jianqing Zeng who accompanied Dr Chung on the day.
Ms Min Rose, Director of Knowledge Exchange and Ms Lei He, Interim Director of the Development and Alumni Relations Office, accompanied Dr Chung to the Li Dak Sum Incubator, where they were able to visit three diverse companies who tenant the residence: Ningbo NoEE e-Propulsion Co.,Ltd., Yikun Sports, and Ningbo Bugge Brand Marketing Planning CO.LTD.
Mr James Birkett, UNNC Registrar, and Ms Lei He provided a report on how Dr Chung’s kind donations have been thus far, and the benefits to UNNC staff and students alike, as well as the wider global community. James expressed his gratitude for Dr Chung's generosity and discussed future opportunities for cooperation, inviting Dr Chung to keep in touch with the university on its journey of continued development.

Loctek supports 38 student awardees in its 2022 scholarship programme with UNNC
20 April 2023
The University of Nottingham Ningbo China has held the UNNC Loctek Scholarship 2022 Award Ceremony on campus, awarding 38 students scholarship awards. This is also the first time that the UNNC Loctek Scholarship has been awarded since its creation in 2020.
In 2020, Loctek Ergonomic Technology Corporation generously donated RMB 3 million to set up the University of Nottingham Ningbo China Loctek Scholarship to support the innovative practice and development of outstanding students. The scholarship encourages students of the University to improve their work skills and employability through subject research, project practice, and internships. The aim is to develop innovative thinking skills which are then applied to solve real problems in the industry.
Founded in 2002 and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange GEM on 1 December, 2017, Loctek is the first A-share public company in the comprehensive health and ergonomic industry and also the first cross-border e-commerce stock listed via IPO. Loctek has set up nearly 40 subsidiary companies in the United States, Vietnam and the Philippines, realising the globalisation of manufacturing, sales and operation.
Since the launch of the Loctek Scholarship Programme at the University of Nottingham Ningbo China, three faculties and various departments have actively participated in the support, and students have also actively signed up and participated. With the joint efforts of all parties, the Loctek Scholarship Programme 2022 has been successfully completed and 38 students were awarded scholarships with the kind support of Loctek.
Presenting the awards were UNNC senior leaders, Professor Philip Seltsikas, Vice Provost for Education and Student Experience, Professor Kok Wei Khong, Dean of NUBS China, Mr Jianhui Mao, Executive Vice President of Loctek and Mr Ye Lin, Director of Human Resources of Loctek. Representatives from NUBS China, FHSS, FOSE, the Careers and Employability Service and the Development and Alumni Relations Office also attended the ceremony to celebrate the outstanding achievements of the award recipients. The ceremony was hosted by Mrs. Lei He, Interim Director of Development and Alumni Relations Office.
Professor Philip Seltsikas was delivered a welcome speech, congratulating all of the scholarship recipients and expressed his sincere gratitude for the generous philanthropic spirit of Loctek and its support of UNNC students’ achievements and a hope for a long and close cooperation.
“Your academic accomplishments and achievements outside of the classroom have been truly exceptional, and we are thrilled to recognise your efforts and successes that have been so well supported by the Loctek Scholarship.”
“Loctek’s contribution to empowering and supporting the next generation of graduates is truly commendable, and we are privileged to have you as our partner in this endeavour. We hope that we can maintain a long and close cooperation.”
Executive Vice President Mr Jianhui Mao congratulated all scholarship recipients and expressed sincere thanks to UNNC teachers and staff members who have worked hard for the Loctek Scholarship Programme 2022.
“UNNC is a great university that emphasises international education, and is committed to cultivating talents with international vision and cross-cultural communication skills. UNNC offers unique instruction approaches encouraging students to actively explore and innovate in their study and research, combining theory and practice, and providing students with rich opportunities for internship and practice...UNNC has a strong faculty team who come from all over the world and are leading scholars in their fields. For this reason, in addition to the Loctek scholarship, we are pleased to see the deepening collaboration between Loctek and UNNC.”
After Mr Mao’s speech, Clara Priscilla Tham, representative for those receiving awards, a final-year International Business Management Student from Indonesia delivered her acceptance speech: “Loctek is actually encouraging us to think and apply theories we study at school in a real company situation...It felt that I was in a professional environment where I get to pitch in a presentation of my ideas, along with the arguments on how I could make it feasible. A truly new and meaningful experience for me that I could learn how to multi-task and learn how to be more confident with myself.”
Mr Ye Lin, Director of Human Resources of Loctek, gave a speech on the company's talent training and school recruitment in 2023. After the introduction, Loctek answered several questions from the students.
After the ceremony, Professor Kok Wei Khong, Dean of NUBS China, Mr Mao, Executive Vice President and other representatives from UNNC and Loctek discussed how to strengthen talent training in the future, providing students with more employment guidance through their Ingenuity Lab and Seeds Programme.

2023 Dream Scholarship and Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship Award Ceremony was successfully held
12 April 2023
13 student groups and 35 students receive scholarship awards in joint Dream Scholarship and Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship ceremony.
The University of Nottingham Ningbo China has held its annual joint UNNC Dream Scholarship and Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship Award Ceremony on campus.
The Dream Scholarship and Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship are both important donation projects funded and supervised by UNNC Education Foundation. The Dream Scholarship was established in 2013 by the late President Professor Yang Fujia. After the sad loss of Professor Yang last July, Wanli Education Group picked up the baton to continue the scholarship. The scholarship was set up to inspire students, especially those who are keen to try new things and ideas and apply these to real-life situations. The Dream Scholarship is one of UNNC’s most important awards to recognise students’ creative endeavours. The Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship was donated by Dr. Li Dak Sum and his wife Mrs. Li Yip Yio Chin. This scholarship aims to award outstanding students who showcase the values of honesty, trustworthiness, patriotism, innovation, diligence, self-discipline and are role models in both personal character and their studies.
The ceremony, facilitated by the Education Foundation Secretariat in Development and Alumni Relations Office in partnership with the Department of Campus Life, was pleased to welcome 68 students who attended the ceremony at UNNC’s Liberal Arts Hotel and were award recipients.
Presenting the awards were UNNC senior leaders, Professor Philip Seltsikas, Vice Provost for Education and Student Experience, Thomas Murphy, Chief Financial and Planning Officer. Representatives from the Department of Campus Life, the Student Recruitment and Admission Office, and the Development and Alumni Relations Office also attended the ceremony to celebrate the outstanding achievements of the award recipients. The ceremony was hosted by Luxi Cai, a second-year student reading international business and management.
After stunning performances from UNNC’s very own symphony orchestra, as well as beautiful piano performances from UNNC students, the award ceremony commenced. In his welcome speech, Professor Philip Seltsikas expressed his gratitude to the generous philanthropic spirit of the donors, and their support of UNNC students’ achievements.
Professor Philip Seltsikas continued by congratulating the scholarship winners, “We believe in your potential, and we are invested in your continued growth and development. As you move forward in your academic and professional pursuits, I encourage you to continue to work hard, stay curious, and remain engaged in your communities. Whether you pursue research, volunteer work, or career opportunities, know that you have the potential to make the world better.”
During the event, Luxi Cai and Xuanyi Mou, representatives of the Dream Scholarship, delivered engaging personal presentations of their experiences.
Growing up in a multicultural environment, Luxi Cai found herself this March as one of only two representatives of China at the 2023 UNODC Youth Forum in Vienna, Austria, where she discussed drug control topics with students from 28 countries and regions around the world. The experience has strengthened her determination to devote herself to anti-drug education in the future. “It is an honour to receive the Dream Scholarship Individual Award-Practical Activities. Thanks to UNNC for providing us with this great platform with great possibilities, giving us the opportunity to learn, explore and grow.” said Luxi.
Xuanyi Mou, the representative of the Dream Scholarship Group Award, showcased the highlights of Student Personal Development Programme Office (SPDPO). As a student organisation responsible for the operation of the credit policy for Practice Course, an important part of Chinese Culture Course, SPDPO works efficiently and effectively, which has been widely recognised and praised. Xuanyi said: "It is a great honour for SPDPO to receive the Dream Scholarship Group Award. SPDPO will continue enthusiastically helping every student."
Representing the Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship recipients, Zixun Zhou, a second-year student reading finance, accounting and management, said: “I came to UNNC by chance, UNNC is 4059 km away from my hometown Hami, Xinjiang. I am very happy and honoured to again be eligible for the Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship. I will continue to learn and grow up at UNNC with the encouragement of Dr Li Dak Sum and Mrs Li Yip Yio Chin.”
The award ceremony came to a close with networking opportunities between guests and a cross-cultural banquet on campus.

title: The journey of the International Communication major student, Zeyang Wang
content: During his second-year summer holidays, Zeyang had a full schedule. He attended the EU Sustainable Development Journalism Summer School organised by the School of International Communications. He learned about the sustainable development goals of the United Nations and the European Union, as well as China's grand blueprint. During this period, he also learned multimedia journalism from the perspective of sustainable development, and co-authored a group report presentation on the theme of "Environmental Protection and Fashion in Parallel", which won high praise from teachers. In addition, he also participated in the Mobile Research Summer School organised by the School of International Communications, where he explored the development context of China Mobile Research and the international strategy of multimedia development under the guidance UNNC academics. As well as this, Zeyang also has several ongoing internships on different platforms to enrich his social practice experience. He serves as a "Content experience officer" on the 36Kr news information platform, sharing his views and opinions.

title: Academic Recruitment Campaign
content:
About the School of Education and English
The School of Education and English (EdEn) at UNNC brings together the tremendous skills and expertise of our schools in the UK and Malaysia, encouraging our academics here to work together on programmes and projects involving Applied Linguistics, International Higher Education, TESOL, Translation and Interpreting, Cognitive Neuroscience, Educational Leadership and Management, Literature and Drama, and many other fields. We produce world-leading research in these areas and welcome people interested in any aspects of language or pedagogy, and in particular those who work collaboratively across traditional disciplinary boundaries.
Our vision aligns with that of the university as a whole: to be a university without borders, where we embrace the opportunities presented by a changing world, and where ambitious people and a creative culture will enable us to change the world for the better.
To achieve this, our Education experts train hundreds of teachers each year and work with hundreds of others on higher degrees and professional development. Our other degree courses provide gateways to many careers. Our English students develop understanding of the ways that language works - in the professions, in literature, and in academia - and how it has developed as a communication tool for worldwide. In doing so, our students prepare themselves for employment in a vast range of areas, such as business and finance, journalism, publishing and teaching. Our Translation and Interpreting students are directly trained in the necessary skills by our team of professionals, and while many go on to work as translators and interpreters, many also use their skills to facilitate careers in industry, the public sector, or teaching.
Our courses deepen students’ appreciation of the nature of teaching and learning, the complexity and creativity of the English language, and the nature of human talk and communication.  Most importantly, students learn how to think critically, how to research effectively, and how to communicate in a wide variety of contexts. All of our students engage in active research, and our staff engages in research-led teaching. As a result, our graduates are highly successful in going on to further study and careers at prestigious institutions where advanced communication skills, analytical abilities and cultural awareness are highly sought after.
Highlights of Teaching and Research
Two of our modules,
EDEN1003 Academic Community
and
EDEN1005 Introduction to Drama
, have received
Provincial First Class Module Awards
, and the latter has been nominated for a national award. Our teaching staff have been recipients of municipal teaching awards, along with the university’s Lord Dearing Award and the Vice-Chancellor’s Medal. Through participation in the Postgraduate Certificate in Higher Education, our staff are all Associate Fellows and above in the Higher Education Academy. Our experts train teachers from the Beijing Institute of Education, participate in the Cambridge Professional Development Qualification Programme, work with China Daily’s 20th Century English TESOL experts, and supervise the next generation of educational experts through out prestigious professional Doctorate in Education (EdD).
Our staff have been key members of the
RICH-Ed Erasmus project
, the
Chinese Society of Multilingualism and Multilingual Education,
and our Cognitive Neuroscience of Language Laboratory has produced some of the university’s top research, including such work as the following: Wei, D., Gillon Dowens, M. & Guo, T. (2018). Early lexical processing of Chinese words indexed by visual Mismatch Negativity effect.
Scientific Reports
.
You can read more about our talented staff and their research on the
School’s website
.
General Job Description and Criteria
The School of EdEn is consistently growing and developing into new areas of language and education, so we are seeking people who are committed to guiding that growth while also continuing to deliver on the excellent programmes already in place.
To that end, successful candidates are expected to undertake academic leadership and managerial responsibilities at all levels of the university. Our staff contribute in our own School, but also to teaching, research and administration with all UNNC colleagues.
People with forward-thinking ideas for new modules, programmes, outreach activities and collaboration at all levels are particularly welcome.

title: Academic Recruitment Campaign
content:
About the School of International Studies
The School of International Studies comprises political scientists, experts in International Relations and historians, together with specialists in anthropology, security studies, development, area studies and other fields in the social sciences. Currently the school offers two BA degrees, two MA degrees, and PhD level studies, and our students – many of whom also learn a modern European or Asian language as part of their degree programme – continue to postgraduate level study in some of the world’s top universities. With 15 academic staff members from 13 different countries, the school adopts a multicultural, international, and transnational approach to teaching and research.
Highlights of Teaching and Research
The School of International Studies has entered a period of growth and we are interested in hearing from candidates with expertise and research interests in the above areas. The school also welcomes applications from candidates who can build new teaching and research capacity in applied areas of political science, social and public policy, including but not limited to areas such as global public policy and governance, health policy, public and comparative administration, policy theory and analysis, social policy, innovation and technology policy and big data. We are particularly interested in growing our multidisciplinary projects and welcome applicants who will be able to work with colleagues across the faculty and indeed the university.
General Job Description and Criteria
Candidates must evidence ability to teach core and specialist courses drawing on their applied social science expertise and demonstrate ability to contribute to broader teaching in International Studies, which includes interdisciplinary modules in International Relations, Political Science, History, and area studies. Appointed faculty are expected to take responsibility for maintaining high teaching standards and contribute generally to the development of teaching, teaching methods and assessments.
We also require a clear research strategy that has the potential to result in external grant capture and publication in world-leading publications. Appointed faculty are expected to act as principal investigators on major research projects in their field of expertise and identify opportunities for the development of new research projects. Also expected is an active contribution to the Centre for Advanced International Studies and university key research priorities areas.

title: Academic Recruitment Campaign
content:
About the School of International Communications
The School of International Communications at the University of Nottingham Ningbo China is recognised as a leading school of media and communications in China and Asia that excels in teaching, social impact, and interdisciplinary studies and is affiliated to the Department of Culture, Media and Visual Studies at Nottingham’s UK campus.
Research in the School of International Communications is vibrant and multi-disciplinary. Our dynamic and collegial team is active in the fields of media and communication studies, film and television studies, journalism, mobile studies, and game studies.
Staff are consistently successful in international and local grant capture (AHRC, ESRC, Erasmus+, Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China), as well as publishing in top journals including Cultural Trends, New Media & Society, China Information, Games and Culture, Information, Communication & Society and in top University Press such as Oxford, Amsterdam, and Edinburgh.
Our BA (Hons) in International Communications Studies is a provincial level awarded degree which includes a dedicated programme of study in a European or East Asian language. Its sister programme, BA (Hons) in International Communications Studies with Chinese, has proved successful in attracting high quality international students to our school.
We currently run an MA programme in International Communications Studies and also have one of the most successful PhD programmes in the university.
We have been graduating students for more than ten years and our alumni have continued their education in some of the world’s leading universities, including Oxford and Cambridge, worked for companies like Google or L’Oreal as well as having their creations broadcasted on HBO or awarded at the Busan International Film Festival.
Highlights of Teaching and Research
The School of International Communications at the University of Nottingham Ningbo China has entered a period of growth in terms of research activities, student numbers, and engagement with industries. Therefore, we are looking for talented scholars to join our exceptional, vibrant, and collegial team.
Applicants can be at any stage of their career with expertise and research interests in the following areas: Creative and Cultural Industries, Big Data, Film studies, Digital heritage, Digital Humanities, Media convergence, News media and journalism studies, Cultural studies, Gender Studies, Games studies, Celebrity Studies.
General Job Description and Criteria
The successful candidate will conduct research and teaching broadly in the area of media and communication studies on our BA and MA International Communications programmes. Candidates should be working in one of disciplines above mentioned.
The successful candidate will be involved in teaching, research, generating external research funding, and service in the school, and will work in a cooperative and collegial manner with all colleagues.

title: 四年学费全免,李叶耀珍奖学金得主们分享大学学习生活
content:
梁舒扬来自宁诺人文社科学院国际事务关系专业,他学习能力强,有很好的自我规划能力。刚入学时,面对大量的英文文献材料他也有过踌躇,但他很快调整好自己的状态,一点点积累词汇量,慢慢提升阅读速度。在宁诺优异的学习氛围中,在老师的悉心指导下,他的专业水平提升迅速。大三时,舒扬前往荷兰的阿姆斯特丹大学交换,在阿姆斯特丹大学,他与来自世界各地的老师同学们交流。这段宝贵经历不仅开拓了舒扬学业上的视野,同时也丰富了他对自我、他人和社会的认知。在与德国朋友的沟通中,他也坚定了自己未来去德国研习世界文化历史的目标。此外,舒扬对宁波的人文历史非常感兴趣,并立志为保护宁波历史文化遗产做出自己的贡献:他曾前往宁波市天一阁担当志愿讲解员,近距离接触宁波古建筑,深入学习宁波的历史文化;他在校图书馆“数字人文宁波”项目组实习,工作的重点就是把宁波的历史和文化资源进行数字化和信息化。他将所学知识与实际相结合,对人文历史有了全新认识。
梁舒扬说,“我衷心地感谢李达三先生和叶耀珍女士的慷慨解囊,能连续获得四次李叶耀珍奖学金是我的荣幸。我也非常感谢各位老师和同学,正是他们对我的指点、帮助和鼓励让我走到今天。刚入学时,我肩负着奖学金带给我的使命与责任,对我而言这是压力也是动力。四年间,我努力学习,不断锻炼和提升自己,全面发展。我非常热爱我的专业,在这里,我可以和有趣的老师同学共同谈论世界,探讨人生,探索各种可能。在宁诺的这段旅程是我最珍贵的经验、最宝藏的财富。”

title: 学生故事丨蔡露曦 · “风尘仆仆”的追梦人
content: 除此之外,露曦也一直活跃于宁诺的其他第二课堂。她曾担任中国传统文化与儒家思想讲座的翻译,为外国学生们提供传译。尽管准备时间有限,露曦依旧展现出她丰富的知识储备以及专业的翻译能力,最终获得了听众们的一致好评。露曦是图书馆播客节目“随机播放”的固定主持人之一,邀请了来自不同领域拥有不同背景的嘉宾,一起分享关于音乐、艺术、历史、生活的见闻感想。露曦还是校足球队的一员,曾代表学校出征浙江省大学生运动会。她说:“我从小就喜欢运动,尤其羡慕能踢足球的女孩子。当我在国外上小学的时候,这种感觉更加强烈。但很可惜,我一直没有机会接受系统的训练和学习。我非常感激我的好朋友,也是现在的队长,她鼓励我参加选拔并正式加入校足球队。在这里,我能够尝试新事物并不断突破自己。”

学生项目活动办公室获梦想奖学金团体奖项
2023年02月03日
近日,宁波诺丁汉大学梦想奖学金获奖名单正式公布,学生项目活动办公室(SPDPO)获得团体奖项。梦想奖学金作为宁波诺丁汉大学教育发展基金会的重要慈善项目,由已故校长杨福家教授于2013年捐资设立,旨在奖励在第二课堂表现突出、为梦想而努力奋斗的学生。该奖学金共设3个类别的奖项:个人奖、团体奖和梦想基金。该奖项在鼓励学生努力学习、奋发向上、促进学生德智体美全面发展等多个方面具有极为重要的意义。
学生项目活动办公室(SPDPO) 成立于2006 年,隶属共青团宁波诺丁汉大学委员会,现有学分部,监督投诉部,宣传部和人力资源部。SPDPO负责制定并完善项目活动学分制度、完成学分活动的宣传、负责相关审批及监督工作,受理相关问题投诉并定期公示处理结果、举办校内活动或承接大型校级校际活动。本学期SPDPO为校内共计170余场学分活动提供幕后支持,主要面向所有大一学生及部分高年级学生。除此之外,SPDPO 策划并组织开展了“打破常规(Break with convention)”益智竞赛类学分活动,旨在让大一新生们快速熟悉校园及学分制度。
SPDPO主任,理工学院数学专业大三学生,黄宇开介绍到:“我们组织共有58名成员,大家各司其职,协作努力,共同办好每一场活动。团队内部关系十分融洽,充满欢声笑语,大家不仅仅是同事,更是彼此的知心朋友、并肩作战的战友,这使得SPDPO大家庭一直以来都满怀着凝聚力,为同学们提供更好更优质的服务”。
2022年6月,SPDPO基于过往学分板块的实践经验,对蓝色素质拓展学分及黄色安全学分进行了修改与完善,并不断优化与校内相关部门的合作。SPDPO在假期设计制作并印制了首版学分手册,并于新生适应周期间分发给每一位新同学,以便大家能够提前了解学分制度,提前规划与安排。
除此之外,本年度SPDPO持续推进数字化建设,开发并完善了学分系统,大大提高工作效率与准确性,该系统在过去的一年使用过程中收获同学们的好评。接下来,SPDPO将不断完善优化各项流程,进一步提升专业性与工作效率。
黄宇开说:“很荣幸今年我们组织可以获得梦想奖学金。我们始终致力于优化学分制度,提升同学们的参与体验。我们重视每个人的反馈意见,正是这些声音,促使我们不断改进和完善日常的工作。获得梦想奖学金不仅仅是对我们过去工作的肯定,更是激励我们不断自省、提升、优化的动力。我们计划将这笔奖学金用于优化学分系统以及我们的工作流程。非常感谢每一位支持与鼓励SPDPO的同学与老师,我们希望每一位宁诺学子可以通过SPDPO学分课程获取新知识,新体验。十分感谢梦想奖学金评委组对我们的信任,我们将铭记杨校长设立奖学金的初衷,带着这份鼓励,脚踏理想,筑梦前行。在接下来的工作中,SPDPO将继续保持初心,尊重每一场活动,倾听每一个诉求,认真对待每一份工作,热心帮助每一位同学。”

title: 我校李波副教授荣获2022年度宝钢优秀教师奖
content: 李波老师始终以学生兴趣爱好和专业引领为导向,以培养适应社会发展的全面型人才为目标,充分激发学生学习的积极性,促使学生发展独立思考、自主学习和创新能力。他积极参与本科创新人才的培养,带领暑假研究实习生们开展科学研究,增强他们对专业前沿科学问题的了解,培养与提升他们的科研技能,更有指导本科生撰写学术论文并发表在国际知名学术期刊上。李波老师说:“2018年暑假我们一位本科同学的项目让我印象很深刻,他将我们生活中废弃的玻璃瓶收集回收再利用,将这些玻璃瓶粉碎后进行活化,并制作成辅助胶凝材料。这些材料可以取代部分的水泥,用作建筑材料,这个想法一定程度上降低了建筑材料的碳排放,十分环保,也特别契合当今国家的双碳目标。我们希望将以废制废的理念融合到绿色建筑材料中,未来我们也将进一步做这方面的研究,与更多企业开展产学研合作,完善技术并落地开展工程应用,为环保事业做出自己的贡献。”

第二章
业务范围
Chapter II Business Scope
第七条
本基金会公益活动的业务范围:
Article 7:
The business scope of the Foundation’s public welfare activities is as follows:
(一)支持大学教育教学质量和学术研究水平的提高;
(1) To support the improvement of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China's teaching quality and academic research level;
(二)设立奖学金、助学金及奖教金;
(2) To set up scholarships, financial aids and teaching awards;
(三)支持学生创新创业、国际合作交流、服务社会等有益于学生综合素质拓展的各项活动;
(3) To support students and graduates of the University in the areas of innovation and entrepreneurship, international communication, contribution to the society and other activities conducive to the development of students' comprehensive quality;
(四)资助大学间国际教学及科研合作项目的开展和国际学术会议;
(4) To fund the development of inter-university international teaching and research cooperation projects and international academic conferences;
(五)支持与教育相关的社会公益项目;
(5) To support education-related public welfare causes;
(六)支持大学教学与研究设施的建设与改善(包括建筑物、仪器设备和图书资料等)。
(6) To support the construction and improvement of teaching and research facilities of the University (including buildings, instruments and equipment, books and materials, etc.).
第三章
组织机构、负责人
Chapter III Organization Structure and Persons in Charge
第八条
本基金会由
6
名理事组成理事会。
Article 8:
The Board of the Foundation is composed of 6 Members.
本基金会理事每届任期为
3
年,任期届满,连选可以连任。
Each service term of the Board Member is 3 years. Members could serve consecutively if he /she is selected consecutively.
第九条
理事的资格:
Article 9:
Qualification of Board Members
(一)热心基金会所从事的公益事业,拥护本基金会的章程;
(1) Enthusiasm for the public welfare in which the Foundation is engaged and committed to upholding the Constitution of EFUNNC.
(二)有加入本基金会的意愿;愿意付出时间和精力去推动基
金各项活动,愿意为宁波诺丁汉大学未来的成功而承担责任或义务;
(2) Have the intention to join the Foundation; willing to devote time and energy to promote the Foundation’s activities; willing to take responsibilities for the future success of UNNC and the Foundation.
(三)对本基金会有实质性的大额支持,有其个人或专业领域的人脉网络,对于给学校的慈善支持特别是高端支持上施加影响力。
(3) Have substantial financial contribution to the Foundation; have the value of and access to their current personal and professional networks; have great influence on philanthropic support to the University and the Foundation, particularly high-end support.
(四)独立、客观、谨慎地参与议事决策;
(4) Participate in the discussion and decision-making independently, objectively and prudently.
(五)尽职尽责,廉洁自律;
(5) Be conscientious and self-disciplined.
(六)保障捐赠财产的使用符合捐赠人的意愿和基金会的公益目的,保障基金会财产的安全及保值增值。
(6) Ensure that the use of the donated properties complies with the donors’ will and the public welfare purposes of the Foundation, and ensure the safety of the foundation properties and assets as well as its fund value.
第十条
理事的产生和罢免:
Article 10:
Board members election and removal
(一)第一届理事由业务主管单位、主要捐赠人、发起人分别提名并共同协商确定。
(1) The first members should be nominated, negotiated and decided by the Business Supervisors, main donators and the originator;
(二)理事会换届改选时,由业务主管单位、理事会、基金会党组织、主要捐赠人共同提名候选人并组织换届领导小组,组织全部候选人共同选举产生新一届理事。
(2) The Business supervisors, the Foundation Board, the Foundation’s Party committee and main donors should nominate candidates together and organize the working group for the election for the next term of office of Board members;
(三)罢免、增补理事应当经理事会表决通过,报业务主管单位审查同意;
(3) Removal and adding new members of the Board should be voted and approved by the Foundation Board and also need to be reported to the business supervisor for review and approval;
(四)理事的选举和罢免结果报登记管理机关备案。
(4) The results of election or removal of Board members should be reported to registration & administration authority for archiving.
(五)具有近亲属关系的不得同时在本基金会理事会任职。
Those with close relatives shall not serve on the Board of the Foundation at the same time.
第十一条
理事的权利和义务:
Article 11:
The rights and obligations of Board members are as follows:
(一)遵守基金会章程,拥护基金会宗旨;
(1) Abide by the Constitution of EFUNNC, committed to upholding the mission of the Foundation;
(二)参加基金会理事会议,执行理事会决议;
(2) Participate in the Board meeting, and implement the resolution of the Board meeting;
(三)享有本基金会理事会的选举权、被选举权和表决权;
(3) Right to elect, be elected and vote;
(四)参加和支持本基金会的活动;完成本基金会的工作任务。
(4) Participate in and support the Foundation's activities; fulfil tasks allocated by the Foundation.
(五)对本基金会工作的批评建议权和监督权,对基金会的领导层提出政策建言和战略设想,有助于推进本基金会的成功;
(5) The right to review, suggest and supervise the Foundation's policy/work, recommend to the Foundation's executive leadership regarding the policy and strategies that will enhance the success of the Foundation;
(六)履行职责,切实维护本基金会的合法权益和声誉,保证捐赠资金的合法使用;
(6) Safeguard the legitimate rights and reputation of the Foundation; ensure the legitimate use of the donation funds;
(七)通过组织或出席各种会议、活动等积极为本基金会筹集资金;
(7) Actively advocate for fundraising for the Foundation through hosting of and attending at meetings and events;
(八)为本基金会开展合作提供有用信息;
(8) Provide valuable information for the Foundation's external cooperation;
(九)对任职期间知悉的基金会未公开信息负有保密义务,但法律法规另有规定的除外。
(9) Be obliged to keep confidential of the undisclosed information of the Foundation that he/she gets to know during his/her terms of office, except those otherwise stipulated by laws and regulations.
第十二条
本基金会的决策机构是理事会。理事会行使下列职权:
Article 12:
The Board is the decision-maker of the Foundation. The rights of the Board are as follows:
(一)制定、修改章程;
(1) To develop and revise the Constitution;
(二)选举、罢免理事长、副理事长、秘书长;
(2) To elect and remove the Chairman of the Board, Vice Chairman of the Board and Secretary-General;
(三)决定重大业务活动计划,包括资金的募集、管理和使用计划;
(3) To make decision of major business plans including plans of fundraising, fund management and fund usage;
(四)年度收支预算及决算审定;
(4) To approve annual income and expenditure budgets and to review last year’s annual financial reports;
(五)制定内部管理制度;
(5) To develop the internal administrative regulations and procedures;
(六)决定设立办事机构、分支机构、代表机构;
(6) To make decisions of setting up internal organizations, branches and representative offices;
(七)决定由秘书长提名的副秘书长和各机构主要负责人的聘任;
(7) To make decision on the appointment of main persons in charge of all internal business units nominated by the Secretary-General;
(八)听取、审议秘书长的工作报告,检查秘书长的工作;
(8) To review the work report made by Secretary-General; to check works of Secretary-General;
(九)决定基金会的分立、合并或终止;
(9) To make decision on separation, combination or termination of the Foundation;
(十)决定其他重大事项。
(10) To make decisions on other major issues.
第十三条
理事会每年召开
2
次会议。理事会会议由理事长负责召集和主持。
Article 13:
The Board meetings are held twice a year. The Board meetings should be convened and chaired by the Chairman of the Board.
有
1/3
理事提议,必须召开理事会会议。如理事长不能召集,提议理事可推选召集人。
The Board must have a meeting if one third Members proposed to have a Board meeting. If the Chairman could not convene the meeting, Members who proposed the meeting could elect a Convener.
召开理事会会议,理事长或召集人需提前
5
日通知全体理事、监事。
The Chairman of the Board or the Convener should give 5 days’ notice to all the Members for holding Board meetings.
第十四条
理事会会议须有
2/3
以上理事出席方能召开;理事会决议须经出席理事过半数通过方为有效。
Article 14:
The Board meeting could only be convened when more than two thirds Members of the Board's present. The decisions made by the Board could be only valid with the agreement of over half Members present.
下列重要事项的决议,须经出席理事表决,
2/3
以上通过方为有效:
The decisions on major matters below will be only valid with the agreement of two thirds Members who presented the meeting.
(一)
章程的修改;
(1) Amendment of Constitution;
(二)选举或者罢免理事长、副理事长、秘书长;
(2) To elect and remove the Chairman of the Board, Vice Chairman of the Board and Secretary-General;
(三)章程规定的重大募捐、投资活动;
(3) Major fundraising and investment activities specified by the Constitution;
(四)基金会的分立、合并;
(4) Separation and combination of the Foundation
第十五条
理事会会议应当制作会议记录。形成决议的,应当当场制作会议纪要,并由出席理事审阅、签名。理事会决议违反法律、法规或章程规定,致使基金会遭受损失的,参与决议的理事应当承担责任。但经证明在表决时反对并记载于会议记录的,该理事可免除责任。
Article 15:
Meeting minutes should be prepared for Board meetings. Where a resolution is made over the meeting, the meeting summary should be prepared during the meeting and Members present should review and sign off the summary. The Board Members should take responsibilities if the Board decision they involved violates laws and regulations and causes the loss of foundation. The Board Members who could be proved of objection of the decision and were recorded in the minutes, the Member could exempt from the liability.

本基金会设监事
1
名。监事任期与理事任期相同,期满可以连任。
Article 16:
The Foundation has one supervisor. Supervisors and Members of Board have the same period of term of service. Both of them could serve consecutively.

理事、理事的近亲属和基金会财会人员不得任监事。
Article 17:
The Board Members, the close relatives of the Board Members and financial staff of the Foundation could not be appointed as supervisors.
